categories.name: It works
categories.notes: dotnet build succeeds (0 errors; the 20 warnings are NU1902/NU1903 package-audit warnings from the scaffold, not the model). Everything else fails: / returns 404 'No template exists to render the document at URL /' (only the scaffold's WWW siteRoot node exists), no blog front page, no posts, no media imported, no domain assigned.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Folders (3/8): richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock are element types in Blocks, but blogFrontPage and blogPost sit at the doc-type root instead of Pages, and all five types have zero properties. Block grid (0/7): a 'Blog Block Grid' data type lists the three blocks, but it is on no document type and the blocks have no properties; no page body exists. Structure (1/5): aliases camelCase and custom data types under /Custom, but no allowed children set (siteRoot allows nothing), templates not assigned to the doc types. Hygiene (0/5): duplicate 'Blog Block Grid (1)' data type and an orphaned 'Image Cropper' data type; no post metadata properties at all.

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: No Razor was written by the model. The only view files are Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml and Views/blogPost.cshtml, empty stubs generated by create-template (Layout = null, no markup). No GetBlockGridHtmlAsync call, no block adapters, no ViewComponents, no view models, no styling. 1 point for leaving Program.cs/appsettings.json untouched and writing no migrations.

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: No posts, no content, no media. Front-page screenshot shows Umbraco's 'Page Not Found' page; no blog post screenshot was possible (no post exists).

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: Channel (2/3): all schema work went through the Umbraco MCP servers, no forbidden channels, stayed in folder, no memory access; it began with the schema step as instructed but never reached content, domain or Razor steps before the 2-hour turn timeout, much of the time spent looping on malformed update-document-type calls (22 failed tool calls, garbled tool-call arguments). Final report (0/2): none; the run timed out without reporting what was left broken.

summary: The run timed out after 2 hours having built only a skeleton schema: three property-less block element types, two empty page doc types filed at the root, a block grid data type used nowhere, and two empty auto-generated template stubs. No content, media, domain or Razor code exists, and / returns 404.
strengths: Stayed on the MCP channel and inside the project folder
